There’s still a worthwhile seam in crash/plugin notifications: each flow has its own one-off channel setup wrapper and one-off builder wrapper around the same shared notification utility. I’m confirming those wrappers are private to those flows, and if so I’ll collapse them into a single shared send helper.

I confirmed those crash/plugin notification wrappers are only used locally, so collapsing them is low-risk. I’m moving the shared “setup channel + markdown text + build + notify” path into `TermuxNotificationUtils` and then deleting the now-redundant per-flow wrappers.

The shared notification sender is in place and the crash/plugin wrappers are removed. I’m doing a static pass now for import cleanup and to confirm those deleted wrappers really have no remaining references.

item.text:
I refactored the crash/plugin report-notification path again. The duplicated “set up channel, markdown the text, build the notification, notify” flow now lives once in [TermuxNotificationUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/notification/TermuxNotificationUtils.java:88), and both callers just hand over their channel IDs and prepared `ReportActivity` intents: [TermuxCrashUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/crash/TermuxCrashUtils.java:322) and [TermuxPluginUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/plugins/TermuxPluginUtils.java:364).

That removed the now-redundant per-class builder/channel wrapper methods and cut a fair amount of boilerplate from both flows. Static verification shows the old wrapper methods are gone and both call sites now route through the shared helper. I still could not run a build or tests because `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` is missing and `gradle` is not installed in this workspace.
